messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC follow-up: deployment mode & success criteria (Acme)

Hi Alex / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the time today - good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same baseline: 

Call recap (notes):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for search-relevance re-ranking and customer support summarization at 1M requests/day peak.
- Current constraints: data residency for EU customers but majority of traffic is US; strict network controls (no public internet from production), and requirement for <150ms p50 generation for short prompts.
- Initial deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest to market), Dedicated capacity (isolated GPU pools), Private VPC/on-prem (for full network isolation).

Marissa recommendation: start with a 4-week PoC on Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) with a private VPC peering option for Prod if the latency and network lock-down prove critical. Hosted API is a backup for feature validation but likely won't meet your networking/SLA needs long-term.

Proposed PoC/Trial plan (high level):
1) Scope: re-ranking pipeline + summarization endpoint (subset of production traffic ~1-2% load)
2) Success criteria:
   - Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for the re-rank path
   - Accuracy: maintain or improve current NDCG@10 by 5% on evaluation set
   - Stability: no more than 0.1% error rate over 24-hour windows
   - Security: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for keys in trial environment
3) Timeline:
   - Week 0: account setup, network intake, share test dataset + evaluation prompts
   - Week 1: model onboarding, baseline runs, initial tuning
   - Week 2-3: load tests, latency tuning, KV/prefix cache validation
   - Week 4: review, handoff, and decision (move to Dedicated or Private)
4) Stakeholders:
   - Acme: Alex Johnson (Eng lead), Priya Shah (Security)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC follow-up: deployment mode & success criteria (Acme)

Thanks Marissa - this is very helpful and in line with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer Dedicated capacity with a VPC peering option. Our security team is open to a private deployment later, but for the PoC we want isolated GPUs with tighter network control.
- Success criteria look good; add a requirement that keys be customer-managed (KMS) for the duration of the trial.
- Timeline: Can we target a two-week accelerated PoC? We can commit to providing the test dataset and an evaluation harness within 2 business days.

Priya - any immediate network intake documentation you need from us?

Alex
